mprCommands.t2: Search and run commands through a floating panel with tracking of recent commands and a list of favorite commands
mprCommands.t4: Search and run commands via the command line built into the Revit interface
mprCommands.t14: Search box and the list of found commands. Allows you to find a command by a part of its name and run it
mprCommands.t15: List of recently launched commands for quickly running them again
mprCommands.t16: List of commands added to favorites for quick access to them
mprCommands.t17: The zone is available only in the full version of the plugin. Enabling this zone triggers an automatic workstation request to the license server
mprCommands.t18: Due to a Revit bug, some commands do not work properly when started from this panel — for example, Copy, Move and others. Run such commands from the Command line mode or from the Revit ribbon.
mprCommands.t19: Revit creates the keyboard shortcuts file only after the first change. Change any shortcut in the settings and they will appear here.
